prose:
An FT item indexed by Techmeme describes efforts by frontier AI labs and large technology companies to counter state-sponsored espionage. The excerpt mentions recruiting people with CIA backgrounds and restricting staff movement as examples of heightened security practices.

The FT article was unavailable, so the summary cannot establish which company uses each measure, its reach, the sourcing or how effective it is. The feed-level description is not evidence of a specific breach or proof that every lab follows the same policy. No private security systems, employee records or accounts were inspected.
highlights: Feed describes concerns about state-sponsored espionage
CIA-linked recruitment is one reported example
Movement controls are mentioned without full context
Company-specific scope and effectiveness remain unverified
No particular breach is established by the excerpt
